watch.summary: The creator reacts with explosive shock and laughter as a seeker in a prop hunt game stares directly at a player hidden in plain sight as a painting.

beats.what: Creator holds his head in hands yelling in disbelief.
The green character turns and stares right at the wall painting.
The seeker strikes the disguised player on the wall.
Creator screams 'WHAT THE FLI-' in utter shock.

watch.author: mixed
watch.why: The creator's high-energy disbelief combined with the hilarious visual of a seeker staring straight at an obvious prop creates an instant, easy-to-understand gag.
